require 'faye/websocket'
require 'rack'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'digest'
require 'uri'
require 'base64'

module FileProcessor
  class WebSocketHandler
    ALLOWED_ORIGINS = ENV.fetch('WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS', '').split(',')
    SESSION_SECRET = ENV.fetch('SESSION_SECRET', SecureRandom.hex(32))
    VERIFY_ORIGIN = ENV.fetch('WS_VERIFY_ORIGIN', 'true')
    UPLOAD_ROOT = '/data/uploads'

    def initialize(app)
      @app = app
      @connections = {}
      @pending_auth = {}
    end

    def call(env)
      if Faye::WebSocket.websocket?(env)
        handle_websocket(env)
      else
        @app.call(env)
      end
    end

    private

    def handle_websocket(env)
      ws = Faye::WebSocket.new(env, nil, ping: 25)
      request = Rack::Request.new(env)
      conn_id = SecureRandom.uuid

      ws.on :open do |event|
        origin = env['HTTP_ORIGIN']
        if origin_permitted?(origin, env)
          @pending_auth[conn_id] = {
            ws: ws,
            origin: origin,
            connected_at: Time.now,
            authenticated: false
          }
          ws.send(JSON.generate({type: 'auth_required', conn_id: conn_id}))
        else
          ws.close(4003, 'Origin not allowed')
        end
      end

      ws.on :message do |event|
        handle_message(conn_id, event.data)
      end

      ws.on :close do |event|
        cleanup_connection(conn_id)
      end

      ws.rack_response
    end

    def origin_permitted?(origin, env)
      return true if development_mode?(env)
      return false if VERIFY_ORIGIN != 'true'
      return false if origin.nil? || origin.empty?
      normalized = normalize_origin(origin)
      ALLOWED_ORIGINS.any? { |allowed| origin_matches?(normalized, allowed.strip) }
    end

    def development_mode?(env)
      rack_env = ENV['RACK_ENV'] || 'production'
      # In development, also check if request comes from localhost
      if rack_env == 'development'
        remote = env['REMOTE_ADDR']
        return loopback_address?(remote)
      end
      false
    end

    def loopback_address?(addr)
      return false if addr.nil?
      addr == '127.0.0.1' || addr == '::1' || addr.start_with?('127.')
    end

    def normalize_origin(origin)
      uri = URI.parse(origin)
      "#{uri.scheme}://#{uri.host}#{uri.port != uri.default_port ? ":#{uri.port}" : ''}"
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      origin
    end

    def origin_matches?(origin, pattern)
      if pattern.start_with?('*.')
        suffix = pattern[1..]
        origin.end_with?(suffix) || origin == "https://#{pattern[2..]}"
      else
        origin == pattern
      end
    end

    def handle_message(conn_id, raw_data)
      data = JSON.parse(raw_data)
      conn = @pending_auth[conn_id] || @connections[conn_id]
      return unless conn

      case data['type']
      when 'authenticate'
        handle_auth(conn_id, data, conn)
      when 'process_file'
        handle_file_processing(conn_id, data, conn)
      when 'status'
        handle_status(conn_id, conn)
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      conn[:ws].send(JSON.generate({type: 'error', message: 'Invalid JSON'}))
    end

    def handle_auth(conn_id, data, conn)
      token = data['token']
      if valid_session_token?(token)
        conn[:authenticated] = true
        conn[:user_id] = extract_user_id(token)
        @connections[conn_id] = @pending_auth.delete(conn_id)
        conn[:ws].send(JSON.generate({type: 'authenticated', user_id: conn[:user_id]}))
      else
        conn[:ws].send(JSON.generate({type: 'auth_failed'}))
        conn[:ws].close(4001, 'Authentication failed')
        @pending_auth.delete(conn_id)
      end
    end

    def handle_file_processing(conn_id, data, conn)
      unless conn[:authenticated]
        conn[:ws].send(JSON.generate({type: 'error', message: 'Not authenticated'}))
        return
      end

      file_path = data['path']
      operation = data['operation']

      safe = resolved_safe_path(file_path)
      unless safe
        conn[:ws].send(JSON.generate({type: 'error', message: 'Invalid path'}))
        return
      end

      result = process_file(safe, operation, conn[:user_id])
      conn[:ws].send(JSON.generate({type: 'result', data: result}))
    end

    # Returns the canonical, validated absolute path or nil if unsafe.
    def resolved_safe_path(path)
      return nil if path.nil? || path.empty?
      expanded = File.expand_path(path, UPLOAD_ROOT)
      root_with_sep = UPLOAD_ROOT.end_with?('/') ? UPLOAD_ROOT : "#{UPLOAD_ROOT}/"
      return nil unless expanded.start_with?(root_with_sep)
      expanded
    end

    # Operate strictly on the already-validated canonical absolute path.
    def process_file(full_path, operation, user_id)
      case operation
      when 'read'
        {content: File.read(full_path), size: File.size(full_path)}
      when 'stat'
        stat = File.stat(full_path)
        {size: stat.size, mtime: stat.mtime.iso8601, mode: stat.mode.to_s(8)}
      when 'checksum'
        {sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(full_path).hexdigest}
      else
        {error: 'Unknown operation'}
      end
    rescue Errno::ENOENT
      {error: 'File not found'}
    rescue Errno::EACCES
      {error: 'Permission denied'}
    end

    def valid_session_token?(token)
      return false if token.nil? || token.empty?
      parts = token.split('.')
      return false unless parts.length == 3
      payload_b64, timestamp_b64, signature = parts
      expected_sig = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{payload_b64}.#{timestamp_b64}.#{SESSION_SECRET}")
      timing_safe_compare(expected_sig, signature) && !token_expired?(timestamp_b64)
    end

    def token_expired?(timestamp_b64)
      timestamp = Base64.decode64(timestamp_b64).to_i
      (Time.now.to_i - timestamp) > 3600
    end

    def extract_user_id(token)
      payload_b64 = token.split('.').first
      JSON.parse(Base64.decode64(payload_b64))['user_id']
    end

    def timing_safe_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end

    def handle_status(conn_id, conn)
      conn[:ws].send(JSON.generate({
        type: 'status',
        authenticated: conn[:authenticated],
        conn_id: conn_id
      }))
    end

    def cleanup_connection(conn_id)
      @pending_auth.delete(conn_id)
      @connections.delete(conn_id)
    end
  end
end
